points.title: 诺曼底继承人
points.description: 威廉出生于诺曼底公国，是诺曼底公爵罗伯特一世的私生子。尽管是私生子，但他是罗伯特唯一的儿子，被指定为继承人。在父亲罗伯特前往耶路撒冷朝圣期间，威廉在1034年被封为诺曼底公爵。然而，他的早期统治充满挑战，贵族们试图废黜他，威廉甚至在童年时遭遇暗杀，导致他的养父被杀。这段经历塑造了威廉坚韧的性格和军事才能，也让他学会了在权力斗争中生存。
points.descriptionEn: William was born in the Duchy of Normandy as the illegitimate son of Duke Robert I. Despite being illegitimate, he was Robert's only son and designated as his heir. While his father was on pilgrimage to Jerusalem, William was made Duke of Normandy in 1034. However, his early reign was fraught with challenges as nobles attempted to depose him. William even survived an assassination attempt in childhood that resulted in the death of his guardian. This experience shaped William's resilient character and military skills, teaching him to survive in power struggles.

points.title: 巩固权力
points.description: 成年后的威廉致力于巩固自己在诺曼底的统治。他成功镇压了多次贵族叛乱，并开始改革诺曼底的管理体系，建立了更有效的中央集权。威廉还与佛兰德斯的伯爵联姻，加强了与周边势力的政治联系。在此期间，他发展了诺曼底军队的骑兵战术，并开始对英格兰产生兴趣。1066年，英格兰国王爱德华去世，没有留下子嗣，威廉声称自己与爱德华有血缘关系，并声称爱德华曾承诺让他继承王位，这为他后来的征服英格兰奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: As an adult, William focused on consolidating his power in Normandy. He successfully suppressed several noble rebellions and began reforming Normandy's administrative system, establishing more effective central authority. William also married the Count of Flanders, strengthening political ties with neighboring regions. During this period, he developed Norman cavalry tactics and began developing interest in England. In 1066, King Edward of England died without an heir, and William claimed a blood relationship with Edward and that Edward had promised him the throne, laying the foundation for his later conquest of England.

points.title: 黑斯廷斯战役
points.description: 1066年，威廉率领诺曼军队在英格兰南部的黑斯廷斯与哈罗德二世率领的英格兰军队展开决战。这场战役是英格兰历史上最重要的战役之一。威廉巧妙地运用骑兵战术和弓箭手，在经历了多次危机后最终击败了英格兰军队，哈罗德二世在战斗中阵亡。黑斯廷斯战役的胜利使威廉成功征服英格兰，为诺曼征服英格兰奠定了决定性基础。这场战役不仅改变了英格兰的政治格局，也深刻影响了英国的文化、语言和社会结构。
points.descriptionEn: In 1066, William led the Norman army to face King Harold II's English forces at Hastings in southern England. This battle was one of the most significant in English history. William skillfully employed cavalry tactics and archers, and after several critical moments, ultimately defeated the English army, with Harold II dying in combat. The victory at Hastings allowed William to successfully conquer England, establishing the decisive foundation for the Norman Conquest. This battle not only changed England's political landscape but also profoundly influenced British culture, language, and social structure.

points.title: 英格兰国王
points.description: 征服英格兰后，威廉于1066年圣诞节在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王。然而，他的统治并非一帆风顺，英格兰各地爆发了多次叛乱。威廉采取严厉措施镇压反抗，包括著名的'北方大屠杀'，摧毁了英格兰北部的抵抗力量。为了巩固统治，威廉没收了大量英格兰贵族的土地，分封给诺曼底的支持者，建立了封建制度。他还下令进行《末日审判书》的调查，详细记录了英格兰的土地和资源状况，成为中世纪最重要的历史文献之一。威廉的统治标志着英格兰与欧洲大陆，特别是诺曼底和法国的紧密联系的开始。
points.descriptionEn: After conquering England, William was crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey on Christmas Day 1066. However, his reign was not without challenges, as several rebellions broke out across England. William took harsh measures to suppress resistance, including the infamous 'Harrying of the North,' which devastated resistance in northern England. To consolidate his rule, William confiscated vast lands from English nobles and granted them to Norman supporters, establishing a feudal system. He also commissioned the Domesday Book, a detailed survey of English lands and resources, which remains one of the most important historical documents from the Middle Ages. William's reign marked the beginning of closer ties between England and continental Europe, particularly Normandy and France.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1087年，威廉在鲁昂的战役中受伤后去世，享年59岁。临终前，他将诺曼底公国传给长子罗伯特，将英格兰王位传给次子威廉二世。威廉的征服和统治对英格兰产生了深远影响，他引入了诺曼-法国文化、语言和法律体系，彻底改变了英格兰的社会结构。他建立的封建制度、中央集权政府和土地调查方法成为后来英格兰政府的基础。威廉的统治也标志着英格兰与欧洲大陆联系的加强，为后来的中世纪英格兰发展奠定了基础。尽管他的征服过程充满暴力，但他建立的制度对英格兰的长期发展产生了积极影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1087, William died in Rouen at the age of 59 after being injured in a military campaign. On his deathbed, he bequeathed the Duchy of Normandy to his eldest son Robert and the English throne to his second son William II. William's conquest and reign had a profound impact on England, introducing Norman-French culture, language, and legal systems, which completely transformed England's social structure. The feudal system, centralized government, and land survey methods he established became the foundation for later English governance. William's reign also marked the strengthening of ties between England and continental Europe, laying the foundation for medieval England's subsequent development. Despite the violence of his conquest, the institutions he established had a positive impact on England's long-term development.

supporter.zh: 威廉一世被视为一位伟大的统治者和改革者。他通过诺曼征服结束了英格兰的混乱局面，建立了有效的中央集权政府。他引入的封建制度、法律改革和土地调查方法为英格兰的长期稳定和发展奠定了基础。威廉还促进了英格兰与欧洲大陆的文化交流，使英格兰重新融入欧洲政治体系。他的统治标志着英格兰从一个相对孤立的盎格鲁-撒克逊王国转变为一个与国际接轨的中世纪国家。
supporter.en: William I is regarded as a great ruler and reformer. Through the Norman Conquest, he ended the chaos in England and established an effective centralized government. The feudal system, legal reforms, and land survey methods he introduced laid the foundation for England's long-term stability and development. William also promoted cultural exchange between England and continental Europe, reintegrating England into the European political system. His reign marked England's transformation from a relatively isolated Anglo-Saxon kingdom to a medieval nation connected to the international community.

critic.zh: 批评者认为威廉的征服过程充满了暴力和不公。他通过武力夺取英格兰王位，导致大量英格兰贵族被剥夺土地，社会结构被彻底改变。威廉的'北方大屠杀'造成了数万平民死亡，是对人性的极大践踏。此外，威廉的统治也加剧了英格兰与诺曼底之间的紧张关系，为后来的冲突埋下伏笔。批评者还指出，威廉建立的封建制度虽然有效，但也导致了长期的阶级分化和不平等。
critic.en: Critics argue that William's conquest was filled with violence and injustice. He seized the English throne by force, leading to the dispossession of numerous English nobles and a complete transformation of the social structure. William's 'Harrying of the North' resulted in the deaths of tens of thousands of civilians, representing a grave violation of human dignity. Additionally, William's reign intensified tensions between England and Normandy, sowing the seeds for future conflicts. Critics also note that while the feudal system he established was effective, it also led to long-term class division and inequality.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，威廉一世是一位复杂的历史人物，既带来了变革也带来了破坏。他的征服彻底改变了英格兰的政治、社会和文化面貌，使英格兰与欧洲大陆重新连接。威廉建立的行政和法律体系对中世纪英格兰的发展产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，威廉常被描绘为典型的征服者形象，黑斯廷斯战役和《末日审判书》成为他统治的标志性事件。历史学界普遍认为，尽管威廉的征服过程充满暴力，但他建立的制度对英格兰的长期发展产生了积极影响，使英格兰成为中世纪欧洲的重要力量。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, William I was a complex figure who brought both transformation and destruction. His conquest completely changed England's political, social, and cultural landscape, reconnecting England with continental Europe. The administrative and legal systems he established had a profound impact on medieval England's development. In popular culture, William is often depicted as the archetypal conqueror, with the Battle of Hastings and the Domesday Book as iconic events of his reign. Historians generally agree that while William's conquest was violent, the institutions he established had a positive impact on England's long-term development, making England a significant power in medieval Europe.

self.zh: 我通过正义和权利成为你们的主人，而不是通过暴力。
self.en: I have become your lord by just and rightful claim, not by violence.

others.zh: 威廉是一位伟大的君主，他征服了一个王国，并统治它如同他自己的财产一般。
others.en: William was a great prince who conquered a kingdom and ruled it as if it were his own property.
